blogSections.title: 面对不稳定，用创新应对
paragraphs: 在拉丁美洲的许多地区，管理资金常常意味着应对不确定性。从货币波动、高额交易费用，到全球金融服务获取有限，个人和小型企业每天都在为维持经济稳定而努力。
在这样的背景下，加密货币正逐渐被视为实用工具，而不仅仅是潮流。该地区的人民正在采用加密货币，尤其是稳定币和数字支付解决方案，以应对现实问题——在不稳定时期保值、接收海外付款，以及在无需依赖传统银行体系的情况下获得数字金融服务。
这种转变在跨境支付领域尤为明显。传统渠道通常成本高、速度慢，并涉及多个中介机构。相比之下，加密货币提供了几乎即时的转账、更低的费用以及更大的可达性——即使是对那些没有正规银行账户的人来说也是如此。
我们在拉丁美洲看到的，不是投机性的热潮，而是一种务实的转型：从数字资产到现实用途，从持有加密货币到将其融入日常生活，从障碍到赋能——由技术推动，服务于本地需求。

blogSections.title: 为何拉美地区的加密采纳路径不同
paragraphs: 在拉丁美洲，加密货币的采纳是由实际需求驱动的，而非市场趋势。与那些将加密视为投机或投资工具的地区不同，拉美更注重其务实功能：当传统金融系统无法满足需求时，提供替代性金融工具。
bullets: 在汇率波动剧烈的国家，加密货币为跨境支付提供了更稳定的替代方案；
自由职业者和远程工作者使用稳定币从海外客户那里收款——通常比传统方式更快、费用更低；
小型企业采用加密货币来扩大客户群，并减少本币波动带来的影响；
对于许多无法获得传统银行服务的人来说，加密钱包成为他们进入全球商业的第一扇门。
paragraphsAfterBullets: 在这样的背景下，加密货币不仅是一种新型金融资产，更是应对区域挑战的实际解决方案。它的采纳增长并非因炒作，而是源于日常用途的驱动。

faqs.question: 卡片有效期过了还能用吗？系统会自动续吗？
faqs.answer:
您好，NewPay 卡片在有效期届满后将无法继续使用，系统不会自动续卡。
如您的卡片即将过期或已过期，您可在 APP 中对应卡片页面申请【补卡】服务。
请特别注意：补发时系统可能默认使用您此前填写的收件地址，若地址已变更，请务必在申请前更新为最新信息，以确保卡片顺利寄达。

faqs.question: 为什么我用虚拟卡刷了一次就失败了？
faqs.answer:
您好，虚拟卡刷卡失败不一定是卡片异常，可能由多种原因导致，例如：
▶ 该商户暂不支持此类预付卡或数字卡
▶ 卡片内余额不足或未完成转入资金
▶  该卡片尚未激活或超过有效期限
建议您尝试在其他支持平台使用，或确认卡片是否已完成转入资金。如持续失败，请联系客服提供交易信息协助排查。

faqs.question: 这个卡可以刷几次？有有效期吗？
faqs.answer:
您好，NewPay 的卡为可重复使用的长期卡片，不限制刷卡次数，只要卡片内有可用余额即可持续使用。
每张虚拟卡都设有固定有效期，通常为 2~3 年，您可在卡片详情页中随时查看卡片的具体到期时间。

faqs.question: 为什么绑定ApplePay/GooglePay 会失败的？
faqs.answer:
我们理解这可能让您感到困扰，毕竟绑定本来应该是个轻松的步骤
别担心，下面是几个常见原因，您可以对照看看：
▶ 卡片尚未激活或未完成转入资金，请确认卡片已经在 APP 里激活，并转入了可用余额。部分钱包在绑定时会尝试扣一笔小额验证金额，如果余额为 0，系统会直接报错。
▶ 填写信息时有误，这是很容易忽略的小细节哦，卡号、有效期、CVV 时请务必核对清楚，数字顺序、有效期格式（MM/YY）或安全码输错，都会导致绑定失败。
▶ 设备或地区不兼容，请确认您使用的手机系统版本、地区设置与 Apple Pay / Google Pay 的支持要求一致。部分地区或设备型号可能暂不支持该功能。
▶网络问题也可能捣蛋，偶尔网络波动或系统异常，也会让绑定失败。可以尝试切换网络、重启设备，然后再试一次。
如果已排查确认了以上事项还不能解决您的问题，建议您截图错误画面并联系客服咨询

faqs.question: 我已经有一张虚拟卡了，还能再申请一张吗？
faqs.answer:
您可以申请多张卡片，但请注意，每位用户最多可拥有5张卡片，包括虚拟卡、实体卡与礼品卡在内。
达到卡片上限后，将无法再申请新的卡片，目前不支持通过停用或注销已有卡片来释放名额。
📌 建议您合理分配现有卡片的用途，确保卡片管理清晰高效。如有疑问，欢迎随时联系客户支持。

faqs.question: 我人在国外，实体卡能不能跨国使用？会被限制吗？

您好，NewPay  实体卡可在全球支持 Visa 或 Mastercard 网络的国家和地区使用，包括线上消费与线下刷卡、ATM 提现。
系统本身不设跨国使用限制，但请注意以下几点：
使用前请确保卡片已激活并有足够余额
部分地区的 ATM 或商户可能因当地政策或系统问题限制接受特定类型的卡片

faqs.question: 在超市刷卡失败，是不是卡有问题？
faqs.answer:
您好，线下刷卡失败并不一定代表卡片本身有问题。
造成失败的常见原因包括：
▶  商户 POS 终端设备不支持当前卡种或读取异常
▶ 网络不稳定或收单系统连接失败
▶ 卡片尚未激活，或余额不足
▶ 当前交易超出卡片设置的限额
建议您检查卡片是否已激活并有足够余额，也可尝试在其他商户或线上平台使用。如问题持续，欢迎联系客服协助排查。

faqs.question: 卡可以用在加油站、便利店这些地方吗？
faqs.answer:
您好，NewPay 实体卡与虚拟卡均支持全球范围内的 Visa / Mastercard 商户网络，包括加油站、便利店、超市、连锁餐厅、电商平台等日常消费场景。
我们的产品具备广泛适配性与国际通用性，让您无论线上或线下，都能轻松完成支付。
建议在使用前确保卡片已激活并有足够余额，部分商户可能需支持感应式终端或插卡功能。

faqs.question: 注销后为什么不能再申请激活卡片？
faqs.answer:
您好，NewPay 账户一旦注销，将无法恢复原有账户与卡片功能，包括重新激活原有的虚拟卡或实体卡。这是基于以下几项重要考量：
▶ 数据保护与隐私保密
 注销操作会触发平台对您的所有账户资料（包含身份信息、卡片信息、交易记录等）进行永久清除，确保符合数据最小保留原则，避免任何个人信息残留或被误用。
▶ 防止滥用与重复认证
 为保障平台安全与合规性，系统会阻止已注销账户再次复用旧身份资料进行申请，以防止一证多号、规避风控、或借他人身份循环注册等异常行为。
▶ 法律与监管要求
根据国际金融服务合规标准（如 AML/CFT 等），平台需确保每位用户身份唯一，注销后不再保留认证记录，因此无法再次为该身份激活先前卡片或账户。
建议您在注销账户前，充分确认自身使用需求。如仍需使用服务，建议保留账户并可灵活管理卡片或资金。如有其他疑问，也欢迎联系在线客服协助。

information.title: 开设账户
information.desc: NewPay App下载、账户注册、身份验证

faqs.question: 如何注册NEWPAY账户
faqs.answer:
访问 NEWPAY 官网或下载 NEWPAY App。
点击「注册」，并填写以下信息：
邮箱地址
输入邀请码（用户 UID）
阅读并同意《注册协议》
点击「下一步」提交注册信息
完成邮箱或短信验证码验证。
设置您的登录密码。

faqs.question: KYC通过后能申请什么功能？一定要认证吗？
faqs.answer:
您好，为保障账户安全与合规运营，NEWPAY 所有核心功能（如虚拟卡申请、实体卡、礼品卡、提现、交易等）均需完成 KYC 实名认证后才能启用。
一旦认证通过，您将立即解锁所有平台功能，享受完整的金融服务体验。
KYC 是我们遵守国际监管标准的必要流程，感谢您的理解与支持。

faqs.question: 审核失败了也不给我原因，我要怎么改？
faqs.answer:
您好，我们理解您希望了解审核未通过的具体原因，但根据合规要求，系统出于安全与防篡改机制设计，可能不会直接显示审核失败的详细说明。
建议您重新提交资料时，请务必注意以下几点：
♦ 确保证件照片清晰无遮挡、四角完整
♦ 上传的证件需为支持国家/地区的有效身份证件
♦ 如为地址认证阶段，请提供包含居住地址的清晰证件页
♦ 避免使用过度美颜、模糊截图等非原始资料
如已确认资料无误但仍遇问题，欢迎联系在线客服协助您核查并重新提交。

faqs.question: 上传文件一直显示模糊，但我看是清楚的啊！
faqs.answer:
您好，您反馈上传的照片在肉眼上看似清晰，但请注意，系统审核依赖图像识别技术，其判断标准与人眼不同。
若图片出现下列情况可能会导致识别失败：
♦ 图片存在轻微模糊、强光反射、水印、遮挡或边角不完整
♦ 文件大小超过 20MB，将无法成功上传
♦ 图片分辨率过低或有压缩失真
♦ 请确保上传的证件完整、清晰、无遮挡、无反光，并控制在 20MB 以下。
以上要求是为满足国际 KYC 合规审查标准，感谢您的理解与配合。

faqs.question: 邮箱/手机验证指南
faqs.answer:
验证流程:
1.系统将在注册后自动发送验证邮件或短信验证码.
2.点击邮件中的验证链接或输入验证码完成绑定.
3.若未收到验证码，可尝试 :
ㅤ3.1 检查垃圾邮箱或短信拦截.
ㅤ3.2重新发送验证邮件/短信.
ㅤ3.3 联系客服协助处理。

information.title: 交易管理
information.desc: 银行卡交易、ATM 取款、付款设置、退款、PayPal 转账、银行卡欺诈、账单

faqs.question: 交易状态一直是‘处理中’，到底扣了钱没有？
faqs.answer:
您好，交易状态为“处理中”时，代表商户已发起扣款请求，但目前还在**“预授权”阶段**，并非最终结算。这笔金额会暂时预扣，但真正的扣款需等商户完成结算流程后才会确认。
一般会在 1~5 个工作日内完成结算，具体时间取决于商户、银行和节假日等因素。
请您耐心等待，系统会自动更新状态，并完成最终处理。

faqs.question: 消费失败但是扣了钱，会自动退回来吗？
faqs.answer:
您好，部分消费在交易失败后仍显示金额被扣，这是因为系统会先进行预授权扣款，用于确认交易有效性。
若最终交易未成功，该笔授权将不会进入结算流程，系统会在一定时间内自动释放预扣金额并恢复到您的账户。
请您耐心等待，通常会在 1~7 个工作日内完成释放，具体时间依商户和清算通道而定。

faqs.question: 为什么会订阅时绑卡失败？
faqs.answer:
商户验证机制限制，部分平台会执行小额预授权验证或需要支持连续扣款（recurring payments）功能，可能不支持此类的验证模式，导致绑定失败。
卡片余额不足，首次免费绑定，多数平台还是有可能会扣除一笔小额验证费用，若卡内无足够余额，将导致验证失败进而导致无法绑定。
部分平台仅接受特定区域发行的银行卡，很可能不在平台的支持范围内。

faqs.question: 我退款了，为什么 APP 还没显示那笔钱？
faqs.answer:
您好，退款流程需由商户发起并完成原路退回。
NewPay 只有在实际收到商户退款资金后，系统才会将该笔金额返还至您的账户并在 APP 中显示。
不同商户和通道的退款时间不一，通常为 3～10 个工作日不等。
如商户已确认退款完成，但超过时限仍未显示，欢迎您联系在线客服协助核查。

faqs.question: 交易记录能下载成账单或者对账表吗？
faqs.answer:
NewPay 支持用户导出交易记录作为对账用途，您可在APP中选择导出特定时间范围内的交易明细。
此外，我们系统会在每月结算后自动将月账单发送至您绑定的邮箱，供您保存、核对或报账使用。

faqs.question: 我在线上购物付款后，页面没跳转成功，会被扣钱吗？
faqs.answer:
您好，如您在线上付款后页面未成功跳转，这种情况不代表交易一定成功或失败。建议您先：
在 APP【交易记录】中查看是否有成功的付款记录 
 登录商户平台，确认订单状态是否建立或已付款
同时建议您在进行线上支付操作时，确保网络环境顺畅，避免中途断线或重复操作。

faqs.question: 消费的时候能不能分期付款？
faqs.answer:
您好，NewPay 卡为预付型卡片，并非信用卡，因此不支持分期付款功能。
所有交易将根据卡片内的可用余额进行即时扣款，如余额不足则无法完成交易。
建议您在消费前确认卡片内余额是否足够支付整笔交易金额。

faqs.question: 刷卡后系统或APP推送通知吗？
faqs.answer:
NewPay 支持在您每次刷卡后通过系统或 APP 向您发送即时通知提醒，便于您随时掌握账户动态。
请确保已开启 APP 通知权限，以免错过重要信息。

information.title: 充值与提现
information.desc: 存取款流程、存取款常见问题

faqs.question: 我钱包显示已转成功，但 APP 还看不到余额，是不是卡住了？
faqs.answer:
您在钱包中看到的“转账成功”是指该笔交易已发送至链上，但 NEWPAY 系统需等待区块链网络确认后，才能完成到账同步。
通常处理时间为 1~10 分钟（视所选网络而定）。
如超过 15 分钟仍未到账，请确认以下信息是否正确：
转账网络是否与您在平台选择的一致（如 ERC20 / TRC20）
收款地址是否为您本次充值页面上显示的地址
转账金额是否符合平台最低充值要求
若信息都正确，可联系客服提供交易哈希（TXID）协助处理。

faqs.question: 收银台地址每次都不一样？我能一直用同一个吗？
faqs.answer: 为防止地址泄露、被篡改或重复误充，我们可能会采用 动态充值地址机制。每次操作请以收银台当前显示地址为准，切勿保存或重复使用旧地址，避免资产异常

faqs.question: 我刚刚转了 USDT，怎么还没到账？
faqs.answer:
区块链网络会存在短暂拥堵现象，可能导致交易确认时间比平时稍长。
USDT 属于链上资产，到账时间会受到所使用链(如 TRC20 或 ERC20)的网络拥堵、矿工费优先级等因素影响。

faqs.question: 我提款到钱包了，可是等了那么就都没到，是不是卡住了？
faqs.answer:
系统显示您的提款申请已提交成功，目前正在区块链网络确认中。
一般来说，链上转账时间会受到当前网络状态影响，可能会有延迟，尤其在高峰时段。

faqs.question: 提款的时候为啥要我开 双重验证2FA？
faqs.answer:
为保障您的账户和资金安全，NEWPAY 在执行提款等关键操作时，会要求开启 双重验证（2FA）。
这样即使账号密码被泄露，也能有效防止他人操作您的资金。
我们建议您绑定Google Authenticato认证工具，整个过程仅需几分钟，但能大幅提升安全等级。

faqs.question: 实体卡明明有钱，怎么我去 ATM 提款却说余额是 0？
faqs.answer:
您好，ATM 提款时所显示的“余额”是实体卡的卡内余额，并非 NEWPAY APP 中的主账户余额。
因此，即使您的 APP 显示账户中有资金，如果该笔金额尚未转入实体卡，您也无法成功提现。
请参考以下两种情况判断处理方式：
情况一：实体卡已转入资金但 ATM 显示 0
→ 请放心，只要实体卡中确实有足够的可用余额，即使 ATM 机界面显示为 0，也不会影响提款操作。部分 ATM 设备在查询余额时无法正确同步显示，但实际提款功能正常。
情况二：资金仍在主账户未转入实体卡
→ 请进入 APP 内【卡片】页面，选择对应实体卡，点击【转入】资金，将主账户余额转入实体卡后再进行提款操作。

faqs.question: 提款那笔记录状态写着‘处理中/交易中’，是已经扣钱了吗？
faqs.answer:
您好，NEWPAY 的提款申请一旦提交，经系统审核通过后即会由出款程序发起链上广播（broadcast），将该笔交易提交至所选网络(如ERC20/TRC20)。
由于区块链交易具有去中心化与不可逆性，一旦交易广播成功，便无法被撤销、修改或中止，无论是用户还是平台方都无法进行干预。
 这与传统银行系统不同，没有“撤回”机制，因此我们强烈建议您在提交提款前，务必确认地址、网络和金额准确无误，以避免因操作失误造成资产损失。

faqs.question: 提款后可以取消吗？
faqs.answer:
您好，NEWPAY 的提款申请一旦提交，经系统审核通过后即会由出款程序发起链上广播（broadcast），将该笔交易提交至所选网络(如ERC20/TRC20)。
由于区块链交易具有去中心化与不可逆性，一旦交易广播成功，便无法被撤销、修改或中止，无论是用户还是平台方都无法进行干预。
这与传统银行系统不同，没有“撤回”机制，因此我们强烈建议您在提交提款前，务必确认地址、网络和金额准确无误，以避免因操作失误造成资产损失。

faqs.question: 我想把钱提到银行卡，可以吗？
faqs.answer:
您好，目前 NEWPAY 暂不支持直接将资金提至银行卡账户。
您可选择以下两种方式进行提款操作：
方式一：USDT 提币到个人钱包地址
→ 手续费依网络而定（由区块链收取 Gas Fee，非平台收取）
方式二：使用实体卡在 ATM 提款
 → 提款手续费为交易金额的 2%，另含适用的银行汇率转换费用

faqs.question: 账户保护
faqs.answer:
保护账户信息，防止未授权访问，是确保资金安全的第一步。
▲ 请勿泄露登录信息
切勿与他人分享您的登录邮箱、密码或验证码。NEWPAY 官方也绝不会主动索取此类信息。若您收到任何可疑请求，请立刻举报。
▲ 开启双重验证（2FA）
通过开启 2FA，登录时需要额外输入一次性验证码，大大提升账户安全性。您可在 App 内【设置 > 安全设置】中启用此功能。
▲ 不要在其他平台重复使用 NEWPAY 密码
推荐为 NEWPAY 设置独立、复杂的密码，避免因其他网站或应用的数据泄露而导致安全风险。

faqs.question: 官方渠道与防诈骗
faqs.answer:
确保通过官方渠道访问平台，并提高防骗意识，是防范账户风险的重要措施。
▲仅使用官方 App 与官网
请只从 App Store、Google Play 下载 NewPay App，或访问官网 www.newpay.org。不要点击陌生链接或扫描未知来源的二维码。
▲及时更新 App 至最新版
NewPay 不会通过 Instagram、Telegram、WhatsApp 等私信联系您索要资料。若遇到自称"官方客服"的陌生联系，请勿提供任何信息，并及时向我们报告。

faqs.question: 操作环境安全
faqs.answer:
使用安全的设备和网络，有助于防止账号被盗用或信息被截取。
▲ 避免使用公共 Wi-Fi 登录账户
 公共网络容易被黑客监听，建议您仅在可信赖的网络环境中登录 NEWPAY，尤其在处理转账、充值、提现等敏感操作时。
▲ 及时更新 App 至最新版
每次 App 更新都可能包含最新的安全补丁和系统优化，请保持 App 为最新版本，以获得最全面的保护。

faqs.question: 卡片与交易监控
faqs.answer:
日常关注卡片动态，及时响应异常行为，能有效降低资金风险。
▲发现异常交易请立即冻结卡片
如果您察觉任何非本人授权的交易，可立即在 NEWPAY App 内冻结该卡片，避免进一步损失，并联系客服启动调查。
▲定期查看交易记录
建议您每周查看一次卡片明细，确认所有支出均为本人行为。如发现可疑项目，请第一时间联系客服。

faqs.question: 注销账号前请三思
faqs.answer:
账号一旦注销，将无法恢复，请慎重操作。
▲ 仅在确认不再使用时注销账户
注销账户后，所有虚拟卡、实体卡、礼品卡及历史交易记录将被永久清除，且无法恢复或重新激活。出于数据保护、身份验证和监管要求，我们不会保留任何可恢复的用户资料。
▲如果只是短期停用，可选择冻结账户或卡片
若您只是暂时不使用 NewPay，建议使用「冻结卡片」功能，保留账户和卡片信息，以便未来继续使用。

topArticles.question: 我已经有一张虚拟卡了，还能再申请一张吗？
topArticles.answer:
您可以申请多张卡片，但请注意，每位用户最多可拥有5张卡片，包括虚拟卡、实体卡与礼品卡在内。
达到卡片上限后，将无法再申请新的卡片，目前不支持通过停用或注销已有卡片来释放名额。
📌 建议您合理分配现有卡片的用途，确保卡片管理清晰高效。如有疑问，欢迎随时联系客户支持。

topArticles.question: 提款的时候为啥要我开 双重验证2FA？
topArticles.answer:
为保障您的账户和资金安全，NEWPAY 在执行提款等关键操作时，会要求开启 双重验证（2FA）。
这样即使账号密码被泄露，也能有效防止他人操作您的资金。

sections.title: 4. PURPOSES AND LEGAL BASES FOR DATA PROCESSING

content.paragraph: We use the personal data we collect for the following purposes:

rows: Identity information, device information, transaction patterns
Contact information, communication records, account information

content.paragraph: The legal bases for processing your personal data include:
subItems: Contract performance: Processing is necessary for performing the service agreement between you and us;
Legal obligation: Processing is necessary for compliance with applicable laws and regulations, such as anti-money laundering regulations;
Legitimate interest: Processing is based on our legitimate interests, such as improving services or preventing fraud, and does not unduly impact your rights;
Consent: You have explicitly agreed to specific data processing, such as receiving marketing information.

content.paragraph: When we process data based on legitimate interest, we conduct a balancing test to ensure our interests are not overridden by your fundamental rights and freedoms. You have the right to object to processing based on legitimate interest.
For data processing based on consent:
subItems: You can withdraw consent at any time, though this will not affect the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal;
Withdrawing consent is as simple as giving consent;
Refusing or withdrawing marketing consent will not affect your ability to use our core services.

content.paragraph: As a Web3 financial technology platform, we use blockchain technology to process digital asset transactions. You should understand the inherent characteristics of blockchains:
subItems: Public nature: Transactions on blockchains are typically publicly visible;
Immutability: Once confirmed, transactions typically cannot be reversed or modified;
Decentralization: Transactions are processed on a distributed network, not controlled by a single entity.

content.paragraph: We distinguish between two types of data processing:
subItems: On-chain data: Information recorded directly on the blockchain, such as transaction hashes, wallet addresses, transaction amounts, etc.;
Off-chain data: Information stored in our traditional databases, such as user profiles, preference settings, etc.

content.paragraph: On-chain data is subject to the inherent limitations of blockchain technology and may not fully comply with certain data protection regulation requirements (such as the right to erasure). By using our services, you understand and accept these limitations.

Wallet addresses themselves are typically considered pseudonymous data, but when combined with other information, they may constitute personal data. We take measures to reduce the association between wallet addresses and your identity, but you should understand:
subItems: Through blockchain analysis techniques, transaction patterns may be associated with identities;
We may need to maintain records of associations between wallet addresses and identities to comply with legal requirements.

content.paragraph: We may use smart contracts to automatically execute certain functions. Regarding smart contracts:
subItems: All smart contract code is audited by independent third parties;
Smart contract operations may not be under our direct control;
Smart contracts may have vulnerabilities or technical limitations.

content.paragraph: We will provide relevant risk notifications and operational instructions before using smart contracts to process your data or assets.
We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data. We share your data with third parties only in the following circumstances:
subItems: When necessary to provide services;
With your explicit consent;
When required or permitted by law.

content.paragraph: We share necessary data with the following categories of service providers:
All service providers are bound by Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) requiring them to:
subItems: Process data only according to our instructions;
Implement appropriate security measures;
Assist us in fulfilling our data protection obligations;
Return or delete data after service termination.

content.paragraph: We may disclose your personal data in the following situations:
subItems: In response to court orders, subpoenas, or other legal processes;
To comply with regulatory obligations such as anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing;
To protect NEWPAY's or users' rights, property, or safety;
To investigate suspicious transactions or violations of our terms of service.

content.paragraph: We assess the legality of each disclosure request and disclose only information necessary to satisfy the request.
If NEWPAY is involved in a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, your personal data may be transferred as part of the transferred assets. In such cases:
subItems: We will notify you before the transfer;
The new data controller will continue to be bound by this policy or at least a policy providing an equivalent level of protection;
You will have the opportunity to choose whether to continue using the services.

content.paragraph: As a global service, your data may be transferred, stored, and processed in locations outside your country/region of residence, including countries/regions that may not have equivalent data protection laws. We take the following measures to ensure the compliance of international data transfers:
subItems: Implementing Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission;
Ensuring the recipient provides an adequate level of data protection;
Obtaining your explicit consent for specific transfers (where applicable);
Only transferring data when appropriate safeguards are in place.

content.paragraph: You can contact our Data Protection Officer for more information about the safeguards for international data transfers.
We implement the following technical measures to protect your data:
subItems: Transmission encryption: All data transmissions use TLS 1.3 or higher encryption;
Storage encryption: Sensitive data is stored using AES-256 encryption;
Access control: Role-based access control and least privilege principle implementation;
Multi-factor authentication: Requiring staff to use multi-factor authentication to access systems;
Security monitoring: 24/7 real-time monitoring for system anomalies and intrusion attempts;
Vulnerability management: Regular vulnerability scanning and penetration testing;
Secure development: Following Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices.

content.paragraph: We also implement the following organizational measures:
subItems: Employee training: Regular data protection and security awareness training for employees;
Access auditing: Recording and reviewing all data access activities;
Vendor assessment: Strict evaluation and monitoring of third-party service providers;
Incident response: Developing and testing data breach response plans;
Data Protection Impact Assessments: Conducting assessments for high-risk processing activities;
Security certifications: Following international security standards such as ISO 27001.

content.paragraph: In the event of a security incident that may affect your personal data:
subItems: We will notify relevant data protection authorities within 72 hours of discovery (if required by applicable law);
If the incident is likely to pose a high risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify you directly;
The notification will include the nature of the incident, potential consequences, measures we have taken, and steps you can take.

content.paragraph: Protecting your data also requires your participation:
subItems: Use strong passwords and change them regularly;
Enable two-factor authentication (2FA);
Keep your devices and software updated;
Be vigilant against phishing attacks and suspicious links;
Do not save login states on public devices;
Report suspicious activities promptly.

content.paragraph: We determine retention periods based on data type and purpose:

rows: Until consent withdrawal or account closure

content.paragraph: In special circumstances, such as unresolved disputes, legal proceedings, or regulatory investigations, we may need to extend the retention period for specific data.
To reduce the impact on your privacy:
subItems: We regularly review stored data and delete information no longer needed;
Where possible, we anonymize rather than delete data, making it no longer capable of identifying individuals;
For statistical and analytical purposes, we prioritize using aggregated and anonymized data.

content.paragraph: When retention periods expire or upon your deletion request:
subItems: We use secure deletion methods to remove data from active systems;
Backup data will be overwritten during normal backup cycles (maximum 30 days);
Third-party service providers will be instructed to delete relevant data;
We will provide deletion confirmation.

content.paragraph: Due to the technical characteristics of blockchains, on-chain data (such as transaction records) typically cannot be deleted. In such cases:
subItems: We will delete information in off-chain systems that might associate this data with your identity;
We will take technical measures to make this data practically inaccessible;
We will clearly explain which data cannot be fully deleted due to technical limitations.

content.paragraph: Depending on applicable laws in your region, you may have the following rights:

rows: Obtain a copy of your personal data that we process
Correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data
Request deletion of your personal data in specific circumstances
Subject to legal obligations and technical limitations
Limit our processing of your data in specific circumstances
Receive your data in a structured, commonly used format
Only applies to data processed by automated means
Object to processing based on legitimate interest
We may demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds
Withdraw previously given consent at any time
Does not affect lawfulness of processing before withdrawal
Right not to be subject to automated decision-making
Not be subject solely to automated decision-making

content.paragraph: You can exercise your data rights through the following methods:
subItems: Via the "Privacy Settings" feature in the application;
By sending an email to support@newpay.org;
By mailing a written request to our registered address.

content.paragraph: Please include in your request:
subItems: Your full name and contact information;
The specific right you wish to exercise;
Any information that helps us locate your data.

content.paragraph: We may need to verify your identity to protect your and others' data security.

We will respond to your request within one month of receipt. If the request is complex or you submit multiple requests, we may need an additional two months, but we will notify you of the extension and reasons within one month. We generally do not charge fees for exercising data rights. However, if a request is manifestly unfounded, repetitive, or excessive, we may:
subItems: Charge a reasonable administrative fee; or
Refuse to respond to the request.

content.paragraph: In some circumstances, we may not be able to fully satisfy your request, for example:
subItems: When laws require us to retain certain data;
When data is related to ongoing transactions or legal claims;
When fulfilling the request would disclose personal data of others;
When technical limitations (such as blockchain data) make complete deletion impractical.

content.paragraph: If we cannot fulfill your request, we will explain why and inform you of possible alternatives.

If you believe our processing of your personal data violates data protection laws, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. We encourage you to contact us first so we have the opportunity to address your concerns.

We use cookies and similar technologies (such as web beacons, pixel tags, device identifiers) to provide, improve, and protect our services. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us identify your browser or device.
We use the following types of cookies:

rows: Help us understand how users use our services
Used for advertising and content personalization

content.paragraph: Some cookies are set by third parties, including:

subItems: Analytics service providers (such as Google Analytics);
Social media platforms (such as Facebook, Twitter);
Advertising partners.

content.paragraph: These third parties may use cookies to collect information about your activities on our website and other websites. We do not control these third parties' use of cookies. Please review the relevant third parties' privacy policies for more information.
You can manage cookies through the following methods:
subItems: Browser settings: Most browsers allow you to view, manage, delete, and block cookies;
Cookie banner: When first visiting our website, you can choose to accept or reject non-necessary cookies;
Preference center: You can change your choices at any time through the "Cookie Preferences" page on our website.

content.paragraph: Please note that blocking certain types of cookies may impact your experience and available features when using our services.

Some browsers send "Do Not Track" (DNT) signals. As there is currently no industry consensus on how to interpret these signals, we do not currently respond to DNT signals. However, you can use the methods described above to manage your cookie preferences.

content.paragraph: If you are located in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or Switzerland, in addition to the rights described elsewhere in this policy, you also have:
subItems: The right to lodge a complaint with your country/region's data protection authority;
The right to seek compensation for material or non-material damage suffered due to our violation of the GDPR in certain circumstances;
The right to know the logic involved in automated decision-making and its potential impact on you.

content.paragraph: Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), California residents have additional rights, including:
subItems: The right to know what personal information we have collected, used, disclosed, or sold in the past 12 months;
The right to request deletion of certain personal information (subject to certain exceptions);
The right to opt out of the "sale" or "sharing" of personal information;
The right not to be discriminated against for exercising privacy rights.

content.paragraph: We do not "sell" your personal information but may "share" certain information with third parties for targeted advertising. You can opt out by clicking the "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" link at the bottom of our website.

We are committed to respecting the privacy rights of all users, regardless of their location. If the laws in your region grant you specific data protection rights, we will respect those rights. Please contact our Data Protection Officer to learn about specific rights in your region.

subItems: Email: support@newpay.org

content.paragraph: For general privacy inquiries or to exercise data rights:

content.paragraph: We commit to:
subItems: Acknowledging receipt of your privacy-related inquiry within 2 business days;
Providing a substantive response within 15 business days;
Maintaining transparent communication and notifying you in advance if we need more time.

content.paragraph: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect:
subItems: Changes in laws and regulations;
New business practices or service features;
User feedback and suggestions;
Evolution of security best practices.

content.paragraph: When we make significant changes to this policy, we will:
subItems: Notify you via email or in-app notification at least 30 days before implementing the changes;
Highlight the changes on our website and in our application;
Provide a summary of policy changes, highlighting important modifications;
Update the "Last Updated" date at the top of the policy.

content.paragraph: For minor changes (such as clarifications or error corrections), we may not provide separate notification but will update the "Last Updated" date.

Continuing to use our services after policy updates take effect indicates your acceptance of the revised policy. If you do not agree with the new Privacy Policy, you should stop using our services and close your account.

Protecting your privacy is our top priority. We are committed to handling your personal data in a transparent, responsible, and respectful manner. If you have any questions, comments, or suggestions regarding this Privacy Policy, please do not hesitate to contact us. b. If the commission amount in the Promoter's account has not reached the minimum threshold, the system will automatically accumulate it until the conditions are met;

c. If the Promoter's account or the behavior of their referred users is under risk review, the platform has the right to indefinitely suspend commission settlement until the review is completed; Promoters have no right to object to this.
d. NewPay reserves the right to adjust the minimum settlement amount and settlement cycle according to business needs, without prior notice to Promoters.
